Secure fetch connection

libcurl.js sends HTTPS through a Wisp WebSocket relay. The default is a public demo relay; swap in a Wisp endpoint you control whenever you like.

libcurl.js v0.7.4 · LGPL-3.0-or-later

The relay sees destination host/IP but HTTPS page contents stay TLS-encrypted to the site. Remote pages run in an isolated iframe; cookies and site storage are not shared with this app.
